status: Composition studies, image-generative reconstruction from reference assets; not pixel-exact source cutouts. Use original Figma exports when producing final covers.

prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create ONE portfolio project cover, landscape aspect 4:3, high resolution. Reference image 1 is an approved contact sheet of optical project graphics: retain this contemporary precision striped graphic style, warm white background #f7f7f2, flat crisp optical geometry, and the relevant motif from this sheet. Reference image 2 is actual project content to integrate. Goal: make a real PROJECT COVER that communicates the project's subject while belonging to a cohesive portfolio series. Composition shared across all covers: one recognizable source element occupies approximately 55% of the frame centered slightly right at x=56%, y=53%; behind it one much larger project-colored optical motif extends from bottom-left towards upper-right, occupying about 75%, but the stripes are carefully masked behind the foreground element and never obscure it. Calm warm-white negative space in upper-left. Only white plus one project accent color plus natural neutral material/source colors. Spacious editorial art direction, subtle contact shadow only, no floating browser chrome, no device mockups, no busy scrapbook collages. No cover title, captions, numbers, category labels, logos, watermark or added typography anywhere. Do not just place a rectangular screenshot on a background. Source object should be cleanly isolated and optically integrated. Do not allow lines to run through object. All material imagery must remain faithful to source reference rather than inventing a different product or building. Project AMTEK, logistics. The relevant optical motif is the first/top-left blue perspective corridor of ribs, accent cobalt #244ff4. Foreground subject: a tightly grouped pair of BLUE shipping containers based on the actual container artwork visible in the upper hero area and lower quotation block of image 2. Isolate containers, clean blue steel with detailed ribs, perspective matches the ribbed optical corridor. Containers must be large, clearly recognizable and realistic, taking center-right; crisp white ground, no crane, no logos, no shipping text, no screenshot UI. Optical corridor lines extend below the containers, becoming an abstract logistics path. Preserve the elegant WHITE BACKGROUND rather than recreating the blue website hero. Use blue optical structure at medium density so it complements rather than overwhelms container. Premium technological cover with tangible logistics context.
